lines.en: label streets5:
scene citynoon
Once again, I find myself aimlessly walking through the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发现自己正漫无目的地走在 Kumon-mi 的街上。

lines.en: But, despite it being the middle of the day in what appears to be one of the more urban locales this city has to offer, things seem pretty calm.
lines.zh: 可尽管现在是大白天，而且这地方看起来已经是这座城市里比较热闹的地段之一了，周围却安静得出奇。

lines.en: I’m risking the chance of not seeing Yumi by trying out a different path today, but it's not like she's looking forward to seeing me anyway.
lines.zh: 今天换条路走，就得冒见不到 Yumi 的风险——不过反正她也不盼着见我。

lines.en: And hey, even if I don’t run into her, I’m sure I’ll be able to find something to do.
lines.zh: 而且话说回来，就算碰不上她，我也总能给自己找点事做。

lines.en: After all, Kumon-mi is-
lines.zh: 毕竟，Kumon-mi 是——

lines.en: : Oh, God fucking damnit.
lines.zh: : 哦，操他妈的。

lines.en: scene streetsfive1
: Oh. Hey, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哦。嘿，Yumi。

lines.en: : Don’t ‘Hey Yumi’ me. What the fuck are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 别他妈跟我“嘿 Yumi”。你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Am I...not allowed to walk around?
lines.zh: : 我……不能随便走走吗？

lines.en: : You can...walk as much as you fuckin' like. I just don't want you followin' me and shit.
lines.zh: : 你想走就他妈走个够。我只是不想让你跟在我屁股后面之类的。

lines.en: : I have literally never seen you in this part of town. What makes you think I'd be following you?
lines.zh: : 我可从来没在城这一片见过你。你怎么就觉得我是在跟踪你？

lines.en: : Oh, I don't know. Maybe the fact that you chose the one fucking day I decided to go somewhere else to go exploring?
lines.zh: : 哦，我不知道。也许是因为你偏偏挑了我决定换个地方待着的那一天出来闲逛？

lines.en: : Only reason I came over here in the first place is because I was gettin’ tired of you showin’ up all the fuckin' time.
lines.zh: : 我一开始跑到这边来，就是因为受够了你他妈一天到晚出现在我面前。

lines.en: : You stalkin' me, asshole? Cause if you are, I swear to God I'll gut you like the fucking pig you are.
lines.zh: : 你在跟踪我吗，混蛋？你要是敢，我发誓我会像宰猪一样把你开膛破肚——你他妈就是头猪。

lines.en: Note to self: Yumi apparently owns this city and I am not allowed to go anywhere anymore.
lines.zh: 备忘：Yumi 显然拥有这座城市，而我哪儿都不许去了。

lines.en: : Wow. What’s your problem today?
lines.zh: : 哇。你今天吃错什么药了？

lines.en: if day44 == True:
scene streetsfive2
: Oh gee, I don’t know! Could it be that maybe I’m still a little pissed off about you sticking your fucking tongue down my throat?!
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪，我不知道！会不会是因为你把那该死的舌头伸进我嘴里这件事，我还有点生气？！

lines.en: : Do you think that could be it, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你觉得会不会就是这个原因呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : You just gonna stay silent now?!
lines.zh: : 你现在就打算装哑巴了？！

lines.en: : To be fair, that's not really an easy thing to respond to.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，这种事确实不太好接。

lines.en: : I told you I was sorry, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟你道过歉了，Yumi。

lines.en: : It's not like that was something I...anticipated doing.
lines.zh: : 那又不是我……事先打算做的事。

lines.en: : It just kind of happened.
lines.zh: : 它就是那么发生了。

lines.en: scene streetsfive3
: Yeah. It sure fucking did.
lines.zh: : 是啊。确实是呢。

lines.en: : You know, maybe {i}less{/i} shit like that would happen if you didn’t get a fucking hard-on for every single [teenage]girl who makes eye contact with you?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，要不是你他妈对每个跟你眼神交汇的[teenage]女孩都硬得起来，这种破事说不定会他妈{i}少{/i}一点？

lines.en: : It's going to be hard to put this behind us if you keep bringing it up, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 你要是老把这事挂在嘴边，我们可很难翻篇啊，Yumi。

lines.en: : Stop saying my fucking name. It's grossing me out.
lines.zh: : 别他妈叫我的名字。恶心死我了。

lines.en: : You wanna put shit behind us? I'll do you one better.
lines.zh: : 你想翻篇？我给你个更好的主意。

lines.en: : How about we put {i}everything{/i} behind us and you go back to letting me kill time on my own? How does that sound?
lines.zh: : 不如我们把{i}“所有事”{/i}都翻篇，你继续让我一个人消磨时间，怎么样？

lines.en: : Exceedingly difficult if we're going to keep bumping into each other like this.
lines.zh: : 要是我们老这么撞见，那可相当难办。

lines.en: : Maybe try bumping into a moving truck next time instead. Would save me a hell of a lot of a stress.
lines.zh: : 那下次你不如去撞一辆正在开的卡车。能替我省掉一大堆麻烦。

lines.en: else:
: What, I ain't allowed to be pissed off unless I've got a specific reason? Eat a dick. Some people are just angry, dude. Give me a fucking break.
lines.zh: : 什么，我没个具体理由就不许生气了？去你的。有些人就是暴躁，老兄。你他妈给我消停点。

lines.en: : It’s shitty enough that I have to deal with you in[school]. I don’t want to be dealin’ with you on weekends, too.
lines.zh: : 光是在[school]里要应付你就够糟心的了。我可不想周末还得接着应付你。

lines.en: : You barely come to[school], though.
lines.zh: : 可你几乎不来[school]啊。

lines.en: scene streetsfive3
: Well maybe I’d start showin’ up more if my teacher wasn’t such a fucking douche.
lines.zh: : 那要不是我的老师是个彻头彻尾的混蛋，我说不定会多来上几次。

lines.en: : Since when does trying to stop someone from picking on other girls turn you into a douche?
lines.zh: : 从什么时候开始，阻止别人欺负其他女生就变成混蛋了？

lines.en: scene streetsfive2
: I don’t fuckin’ pick on anyone! That’s just how I talk!
lines.zh: : 我他妈才没欺负谁！我说话就是这样！

lines.en: : Really? Cause this might sound a bit presumptuous, but it looks to me like you might just be trying to get attention.
lines.zh: : 是吗？这话可能有点自以为是，但在我看来，你大概只是想引起别人注意吧。

lines.en: scene streetsfive3
: Pfft. If I wanted attention from you I’d just take my fucking shirt off or something.
lines.zh: : 噗。我要是想让你注意我，直接把衣服脱了不就完了。

lines.en: To be fair, that would definitely work.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，那招肯定管用。

lines.en: But that's not really what we're talking about here.
lines.zh: 不过我们现在聊的并不是这个。

lines.en: scene streetsfive4
: Hah...
Yumi lets out a heavy sigh and slouches down against the phone booth she’s leaning on.
lines.zh: Yumi 长长地叹了口气，身子顺着她靠着的那座电话亭滑坐下去。

lines.en: The glass is too thick to shatter from the pressure of her body against it, but a coffee cup positioned on top of a table falls off due to the phone booth suddenly being pushed backwards.
lines.zh: 玻璃厚得很，光凭她身体的重量压不碎，可电话亭被猛地往后一推，桌上那只咖啡杯却掉了下来。

lines.en: Its contents spill out all over the ground, drowning whatever insects made their home inside while coating the walls in a liquid that will remain unseen for what I imagine will be quite some time.
lines.zh: 杯里的东西洒了一地，淹死了那些把这里当家住的虫子，还在墙上糊了一层液体——我猜那玩意儿在相当长一段时间里都不会有人发现。

lines.en: I feel a sudden compulsion to clean it.
lines.zh: 我忽然涌起一股想把它擦干净的冲动。

lines.en: I don't know why.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么。

lines.en: : You gone yet? Or am I going to open my eyes back up to just more disappointment?
lines.zh: : 你走了没？还是说我睁开眼又要看到更多让我失望的东西？

lines.en: : Aren't you going to go pick up the trash you just knocked over?
lines.zh: : 你不去把你刚撞倒的垃圾捡起来吗？

lines.en: scene streetsfive2
: The fuck do you think, smartass?
lines.zh: : 你说呢，自作聪明的混蛋？

lines.en: : Do I look like the kinda girl who’s gonna spend her free time mopping up some old ass drink off the inside of a phone booth?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像是那种会拿自己的空闲时间去擦电话亭里那摊陈年老饮料的女生吗？

lines.en: : Shit's probably been there for like a month. Ain't my problem.
lines.zh: : 那玩意儿大概在那儿放了一个月了。不关我的事。

lines.en: : You fuckin’ clean it up if it bothers you that much.
lines.zh: : 你要是这么看不下去，你他妈自己擦。

lines.en: : It...doesn’t. I was just trying to make a joke, I guess. I knew you weren't going to actually go out of your way to do something kind.
lines.zh: : 我……没有。我只是想开个玩笑而已。我知道你根本不会特地去做点什么好事。

lines.en: scene streetsfive3
: You call {i}that{/i} shit a joke? Try a lot fuckin' harder, dude. That wasn't even almost funny.
lines.zh: : 你管{i}那玩意儿{/i}叫玩笑？再他妈努力点吧，老兄。那连一点都不好笑。

lines.en: : You say that like you're some kind of comic genius or something.
lines.zh: : 你说得好像自己是什么喜剧天才似的。

lines.en: : Maybe I am?
lines.zh: : 也许我就是呢？

lines.en: scene streetsfive4
: Here's a real joke for ya- What do you call a creepy dude who spends way too much time trying to get in the pants of every [teenager] he sees?
lines.zh: : 给你讲个真正的笑话——你怎么称呼一个成天想着把每个他看见的[teenager]都骗上床的变态？

lines.en: : Me.
: Wrong, it’s-
scene streetsfive5
: Wait, did you really just fucking admit that? Are you insane?
lines.zh: : 等等，你刚才他妈真的承认了？你疯了吗？

lines.en: : I'm not admitting to anything. Your {i}jokes{/i} are just extremely predictable.
lines.zh: : 我什么都没承认。只是你的{i}“笑话”{/i}太好猜了。

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, you're fucking disgusting...
lines.zh: : 天哪，你真他妈恶心……

lines.en: : That may be true, but at least you wouldn't have to worry about me trying to get inside of {i}your{/i} pants if there was any merit to that jest.
lines.zh: : 也许吧，但如果那玩笑真有几分道理，你至少不用担心我想钻进{i}“你”{/i}的裤子里。

lines.en: scene streetsfive1
: Oh? And why is that? Am I not ‘cute’ enough or some shit?
lines.zh: : 哦？那为什么？是我还不够“可爱”还是怎么的？

lines.en: : You into the {i}girlier{/i} types? The ones who can't beat the living shit out of you?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢{i}“更女人”{/i}的那种？那种不会把你打得半死的？

lines.en: : No. That's not it.
lines.zh: : 不。不是这个原因。

lines.en: : You’re just not wearing pants.
lines.zh: : 你只是没穿裤子。

lines.en: : I can't get inside of them because they're not there.
lines.zh: : 我没法钻进去，因为它根本不在那儿。

lines.en: : Because...you're wearing a skirt.
lines.zh: : 因为……你穿的是裙子。

lines.en: : Which technically isn't pants.
lines.zh: : 严格来说那不算裤子。

lines.en: : There are just...no pants for me to try and get inside.
lines.zh: : 根本没有我能钻进去的裤子。

lines.en: scene streetsfive6
: Pfft...
scene streetsfive7
: Funny shit.
lines.zh: : 挺好笑的。

lines.en: : You know, for a second I thought you might actually start laughing.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，有那么一瞬间我以为你真的会笑出来。

lines.en: : As fucking if. Would have to be some sort of...shitty fucking alternate timeline or something for me to laugh at a shitty joke like that.
lines.zh: : 想他妈得美。我得活在某种……烂透了的平行宇宙里，才会被这种烂笑话逗笑。

lines.en: : You did kind of crack a smile, at least. Albeit for only like, three seconds.
lines.zh: : 你至少还是嘴角上扬了一下吧。虽然也就三秒钟。

lines.en: : Me? Nah. Didn't happen.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。没这回事。

lines.en: : I literally-
lines.zh: : 我明明——

lines.en: : It didn't. Fucking. Happen.
lines.zh: : 没.这.回.事。

lines.en: : Got it?
lines.zh: : 明白了吗？

lines.en: : Will you hit me if I say no?
lines.zh: : 我要是说不，你会打我吗？

lines.en: : I will fucking murder you if you say no.
lines.zh: : 你敢说不，我就他妈杀了你。

lines.en: scene streetsfive4
: So, now that we've reached an agreement-
lines.zh: : 那么，既然我们已经达成共识了——

lines.en: scene streetsfive1
: See ya.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : What? Already?
lines.zh: : 什么？这就走了？

lines.en: : Yeah. This has already been like fifty times longer than I wanted to talk to you for.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我已经跟你说了比我想说的长了五十倍的话。

lines.en: : That statement implies that there is a measurable amount of desire you have to actually talk to me.
lines.zh: : 这句话意味着，你确实有那么一点想跟我说话的欲望，而且还能量化。

lines.en: : It implies {i}shit.{/i} Now, get lost.
lines.zh: : 意味着个{i}屁{/i}。行了，滚吧。

lines.en: : I don't understand how you can be so rude to the only person who's ever made you smile before.
lines.zh: : 我真搞不懂，对全世界唯一让她笑过的人，你怎么能这么没礼貌。

lines.en: scene streetsfive8
: Oh, fuck off! That shit was barely even a smile! {i}Why{/i} would I smile?!
lines.zh: : 哦，滚你的！那他妈根本算不上笑！我{i}“凭什么”{/i}要笑？！

lines.en: : Your stupid ass {i}joke{/i} wasn’t even funny!
lines.zh: : 你那个蠢货{i}“笑话”{/i}一点都不好笑！

lines.en: : Really? But I explained it so many times and that makes every joke funnier.
lines.zh: : 是吗？可我解释了好几遍啊，而每解释一遍，笑话就会更好笑。

lines.en: : Just fucking drop it, okay?! It’ll never happen again!
lines.zh: : 你他妈给我闭嘴行不行？！这种事不会再发生了！

lines.en: : And if anyone ever finds out that {i}you{/i} of all people got me to crack, I will literally never fucking live it down!
lines.zh: : 而且要是有人发现，是“{i}你{/i}”——偏偏是你——让我破功了，我他妈这辈子都别想抬起头了！

lines.en: : So, again, tell anyone that I even {i}almost{/i} smiled and I swear on everything you love that I will rip your fucking balls off.
lines.zh: : 所以再强调一遍：你要是跟任何人说我还{i}“差点”{/i}笑了，我拿你所有心爱的东西发誓，我会把你他妈的蛋扯下来。

lines.en: : Fine, Yumi. This momentous occasion can be our little secret.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Yumi。这个历史性的时刻可以成为我们的小秘密。

lines.en: scene streetsfive9
: Ahhhh!!! That somehow makes it sound even fucking worse!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！！！这么说反而更他妈恶心了！

lines.en: : Just get the hell away from me, creep! Now! Before I...start screaming that you're trying to molest me or some shit!
lines.zh: : 你赶紧给我滚远点，变态！现在就滚！趁我还没……开始大喊你非礼我之类的！

lines.en: : There’s not only no one around, but we're both fully clothed and there is no way anyone would believe that.
lines.zh: : 别说周围根本没人，我们两个都穿得整整齐齐，而且也没人会信。

lines.en: scene streetsfive8
: So what?! At least if someone else comes, I won’t have to worry about some fucking tall, wonky-ass looking dickwad pushing me to the ground!
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？！至少要是有人来了，我就不用担心某个又高又歪的混蛋把我推倒在地！

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I won't say anything.
lines.zh: : 好吧好吧。我什么都不说。

lines.en: : I wasn't really planning to anyway, but I'll go ahead and confirm that now before you pop a blood vessel trying to summon other people over here.
lines.zh: : 我本来也没打算说，不过趁你还没气得血管爆掉、把别人都召唤过来之前，我现在就先跟你确认一下。

lines.en: : If you think for a second that I'm not burning that image into my memory, though, you're dead wrong and now I'm just going to try and make you smile ten times more often.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是以为我不会把那画面刻进记忆里，那你就大错特错了，而且从现在起我要试着让你多笑十倍。

lines.en: scene streetsfive9
: AHHHHH!!! I FUCKING HATE YOU!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！！！我他妈恨死你了！！！

lines.en: : I know you do. You remind me every five lines of dialogue. Your entire personality is pretty much centered around hating me, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我知道。你每五句台词就要提醒我一次。你的整个人格基本上就是围绕恨我建立的，是吧？

lines.en: scene streetsfive3
: Fuck off. I'm a human being just like everybody else. I've got tons of shit I'm dealin' with.
lines.zh: : 滚开。我跟别人一样也是个人。我有一大堆自己的破事要处理。

lines.en: : But it’s not like someone as shitty and as {i}rude{/i} as me has any chance of redeeming herself, right?
lines.zh: : 不过像我这么糟糕、这么{i}“没礼貌”{/i}的人，大概也没什么机会洗白自己吧？

lines.en: : I'm better off just stickin' to how I've always done things since that'll make shit easier for everyone involved.
lines.zh: : 我还是照老样子来比较好，反正这样对大家都省事。

lines.en: : That’s not true. I actually think you’d be pretty cute if you stopped spitting on cars from the top of an overpass and...threatening to rip my balls off.
lines.zh: : 不是那样的。我真的觉得，你要是不再从天桥顶上往车上吐口水、不再……威胁要把我的蛋扯下来，其实还挺可爱的。

lines.en: Yumi doesn’t respond right away and, instead, focuses her gaze on a few cars off in the distance.
lines.zh: Yumi 没有马上回应，而是把目光投向远处停着的几辆车。

lines.en: She's probably thinking about spitting on them.
lines.zh: 她大概在琢磨往上面吐口水的事。

lines.en: : I think you're a fucking liar.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是个骗子。

lines.en: : But that's not something I'm gonna stand here and talk to you about when I've got other shit that takes priority.
lines.zh: : 不过我可不会站在这儿跟你聊这个，我还有别的更要紧的事。

lines.en: : I’m tired...
lines.zh: : 我累了……

lines.en: : I’m gonna get out of here.
lines.zh: : 我要走了。

lines.en: : Do you want to head back together and-
lines.zh: : 你想一起回去吗——

lines.en: : Fuck no.
lines.zh: : 想他妈的美。

lines.en: : And don't think about following me either.
lines.zh: : 也别想着跟着我。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Just leave me the fuck alone already.
lines.zh: : 你他妈别管我行不行。

lines.en: scene streetsfive10
As expected, Yumi takes off down the street and aggressively tucks her hands into her skirt-pockets.
lines.zh: 不出所料，Yumi 顺着街道跑开了，两手粗暴地插进裙子的口袋里。

lines.en: I watch from afar as she rounds the corner and disappears, heading off to somewhere she can feel alone without the prying gaze of a middle aged man chipping away at her walls.
lines.zh: 我远远地看着她拐过转角、消失不见，去往某个能让她不必被一个中年男人用窥探的目光一点点凿开心墙的地方。

lines.en: I know that, before long, those chips will be large enough to see through.
lines.zh: 我知道，用不了多久，那些缺口就会大到能看穿。

lines.en: But for now, I'll have to resign myself to just watching her walk away like this.
lines.zh: 但眼下，我只能认命地就这样看着她走远。

lines.en: I'm sure there's plenty more of that in store for the future.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，未来这种事还多着呢。

lines.en: scene black

$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has somehow increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度不知怎么提升到了 [yumi_love]！{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
